decision.rationale: TXN-008126 is a 30.05 EUR (3005 minor units) purchase at OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST on card CRD-000036. It posted on 2026-08-02. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 89 days later, which is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation, AUTH-008314, shows entry mode CHIP, PIN verified true and fraud flag false. 3-D Secure was NOT_APPLICABLE and the CVV was NOT_PRESENT, as expected for a terminal payment. This means the card and the PIN were both present. Under unauthorised-chip-and-pin, such a payment is treated as made by the cardholder, and the dispute is declined. Earlier approved purchases on this card at the same merchant support this: TXN-008125 on 2026-05-23 and TXN-008124 on 2026-06-17. The card was also used there again after the disputed date, in TXN-001117 and TXN-001116. The cardholder's statement that the card stayed with them supports the finding that the card was present. It does not explain how the PIN was entered.

proposed_actions.reason: The 30.05 EUR payment to OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST on 2026-08-01 was made in person with your card's chip, and the correct PIN was entered. Your card has also been used at this merchant several times before and after this date. We therefore treat this payment as made by you, and your dispute is declined.
